meta.title: Mothaqaf
meta.description: Mothaqaf — an initiative to build an educated team that believes in learning, growth, and leadership.

heading.title: Mothaqaf
heading.subtitle: An initiative to build an educated team: one that thinks, learns, and leads — with practical Arabic content built on real experience.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To become a more conscious leader, capable of managing people, systems, and decisions — and to document the journey so others can benefit.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To help youth, employees, and new leaders understand the work environment, grow their professional and leadership skills, and make better decisions through simple, fast, practical Arabic content.

about.title: About the initiative
about.body: Mothaqaf is a knowledge project that starts from inside the work environment, not outside it. It doesn't deliver theory about management — but real stories, decisions, mistakes, and lessons from daily work. The goal: a generation of young leaders who understand the work environment, build systems, and make conscious decisions.
